nodes_update.name: Paramahansa Yogananda
nodes_update.note: Born Mukunda Lal Ghosh, Gorakhpur, 5 January 1893; died Los Angeles, 7 March 1952. Founded Yogoda Satsanga Society (1917) and Self-Realization Fellowship (counted from 1920, incorporated 1935); Autobiography of a Yogi (1946).

edges_upsert.note: Met 1910 (SRF; some accounts 1909); trained at the Serampore hermitage about ten years; sannyasa in the Giri order July 1915; title Paramahansa 25 December 1935
Both parents were Lahiri's disciples by the Autobiography's account; the infant blessing and prophecy are devotional story. No direct teaching relationship (Lahiri died 1895).
Autobiography says Babaji appeared to him in Calcutta before he sailed for America and chose him to spread Kriya in the West
Gospel commentary serialized in his magazine, published as The Second Coming of Christ (2004); taught harmony of original Christianity and yoga
By Yogananda's and SRF's account, gave Kriya Yoga instruction to Gandhi and several followers at Wardha, 27 August 1935, at Gandhi's request
Disciple; succeeded him as SRF president 1952
Met and became disciple in Los Angeles 1948; asked to resign by SRF board 1962; founded Ananda 1968

glossary.def: Literally supreme swan; a title for a monk of the highest spiritual attainment. Sri Yukteswar gave it to Yogananda in 1935.
Great samadhi; devotees' term for an accomplished yogi's death, understood as a conscious final exit from the body.
Yogananda's breath-watching concentration technique: the breath is silently paired with hong on the inhalation and sau on the exhalation until mind and breath grow calm.
Yogananda's early name for his system of tense-and-relax energization exercises and meditation, kept in the name Yogoda Satsanga Society of India.

yogananda: Born Mukunda Lal Ghosh, 5 Jan 1893, Gorakhpur; parents Bhagabati and Gyana Prabha Ghosh -> https://www-develop.yogananda.org/press/press-the-life-of-paramahansa-yogananda
Fourth of eight children; father vice-president Bengal-Nagpur Railway; Scottish Church College; BA Serampore College 1915 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paramahansa_Yogananda

Met Yukteswar 1910; sannyasa July 1915; Dihika 22 Mar 1917; Ranchi 1918 Maharaja of Kasimbazar; sailed 3 Aug 1920 City of Sparta; Boston lecture 6 Oct 1920 'The Science of Religion'; Mt Washington dedicated 25 Oct 1925; East-West Dec 1925; Gandhi at Ranchi 17 Sep 1925; India trip from 9 Jun 1935; Bombay 22 Aug 1935; Wardha 26-27 Aug 1935 Kriya to Gandhi; Serampore reunion 30 Sep 1935; Paramahansa 25 Dec 1935; SRF incorporated 29 Mar 1935; Autobiography Dec 1946; Rowe letter 16 May 1952 'No physical disintegration was visible...' -> https://www-develop.yogananda.org/press/press-the-life-of-paramahansa-yogananda

Met Yukteswar 1909; school 1916; Dhirananda left 1929, sued 1935; Nerode sued 1939; Encinitas 1936; Golden Lotus temple 1938, collapsed 1942; Hollywood temple 1942; Lake Shrine 1950; third edition 1951; Kriyananda joined 1948, resignation requested 1962; Ananda 1968 -> https://wrldrels.org/?p=12901
Lessons announced 1934 -> https://yogananda.org/blog/srf-lessons-enhanced-and-expanded-edition-planned-for-release-in-early-2019
Yogoda Lessons passage dated 1924; energization tense/relax, medulla, double breathing -> https://www.ananda.org/Meditation/energization.html
Lessons structure: 18 basic lessons mailed every two weeks; Hong-Sau, Energization, Aum; ~8 months before Kriya application; Kriya lessons in print -> https://yogananda.org/kriya-yoga-lessons

Kriya quotations ('psychophysiological method...decarbonized'; 'revolve, upward and downward, around the six spinal centers'; 'half-minute of Kriya equals one year'; 'airplane route'; 'nothing in common with the unscientific breathing exercises'; 'most scientific avenue'; 'Elijah, Jesus, Kabir...'; Gita IV:29) -> https://hinduwebsite.com/sacredscripts/spiritualism/yogananda/yogananda_26.asp

Ramana visit 29 Nov 1935, with four others incl. secretary C. R. Wright; Wright asks how to realise God; Yogananda asks about spiritual uplift; answer 'differ according to the temperaments...' -> https://archive.arunachala.org/docs/talks-wsrm/106-108
Yukteswar died 9 Mar 1936; returned to America late 1936; photo with Ramana at Tiruvannamalai and Anandamayi Ma -> https://yssofindia.org/paramahansa-yogananda/return-to-india

Death 7 Mar 1952 Biltmore, banquet for B. R. Sen, read 'My India', official cause heart attack, Forest Lawn Great Mausoleum; Time 4 Aug 1952; embalming caveat; citizenship 1949; 1999 HarperCollins list; successors -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paramahansa_Yogananda
Last lines of 'My India' -> https://www.crossandlotus.com/last-speech-given-by-yoganandaji/
Sen: 'gone back three thousand years'; 'a feeling above all of exaltation' -> https://yssofindia.org/paramahansa-yogananda/binay-ranjan-sen
1946 first edition, Philosophical Library, New York; Evans-Wentz preface -> https://raptisrarebooks.com/?p=98527
God Talks with Arjuna 1995 SRF; serialized from 1932; revision 1948; Bhishma=ego (Miller) -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/God_Talks_with_Arjuna:_The_Bhagavad_Gita
Second Coming of Christ 2004; 'to reveal the complete harmony and basic oneness of original Christianity' -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Second_Coming_of_Christ_(book)
Line of gurus; 'When I am gone the teachings will be the guru'; no later leader takes title of guru -> https://yogananda.org/lineage-and-leadership
SRF on later editions: 'none others, incorporate all of the author's wishes'; Tara Mata; rights bought 1953 -> https://yogananda.org/yoganandas-wishes-for-later-editions
Crystal Clarity 1993 reprint; 'substantially change the meaning of the original text' -> https://www.ananda.org/free-inspiration/books/autobiography-of-a-yogi/about-this-edition/
9th Cir. 1995: 'Self-realization' generic as trade name; 'Paramahansa Yogananda' federal mark invalid; composite marks remanded -> https://openjurist.org/59/f3d/902

Jury found infringement of articles and recordings, about $29,000; responses of both lawyers; Bertolucci case separate -> https://www.theunion.com/news/local-news/jury-copyrights-violated-by-church/article_ff8834e4-4078-500b-9d83-62b50d4c18be.html
Ananda account of litigation 1990-2002, public-domain early works -> https://www.ananda.org/about-ananda-sangha/self-realization-fellowship-vs-ananda-religious-freedom-lawsuit-1990-2002/
Kriyananda: b. 1926, met Yogananda 1948, Ananda 1968, Bertolucci verdict 1998, d. 2013 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kriyananda
Foxen 2017 OUP: proto-modern yoga; Unitarianism, New Thought, Theosophy; physical culture -> https://www.india.oup.com/product/biography-of-a-yogi-9780190875749
Audio talks list -> https://yssofindia.org/paramahansa-yogananda/listen-to-paramahansa-yogananda
Awake (2014), di Florio and Leeman, archival footage -> https://www.bostonglobe.com/arts/movies/2014/11/07/awake-offers-little-enlightenment/Pt8ybTlnl0j0Q0VKIDl9bI/story.html
